repo: Phase 22 is named 'performance-baselines-completion' — slug used for branch naming as feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion
GSD branching strategy for this project is 'phase', producing branches like feat/phase-{N}-{slug}
All 3 plans in phase 22 fall in wave 1 (no inter-plan dependencies), enabling full parallelization
Phase 22 plans cover: SDK Performance API instrumentation (22-01), Playwright E2E journey timing tests (22-02), and load test thresholds + capacity model doc (22-03)
workflow: GSD execute-phase init outputs executor_model, verifier_model, parallelization, branching_strategy, branch_name, and plan inventory in one CLI call
When a pre-existing feature branch matches the GSD-computed branch name, the workflow should reuse it rather than attempt checkout -b
The stale auto-chain flag must be cleared at execute-phase init when --auto is not passed, to prevent previous interrupted runs from triggering unwanted auto-advance
Executor subagents receive paths only and load all context themselves, keeping orchestrator context at ~10-15%
